generatedCommentsNodes.comment:
Typo in variable name: `MULTILINUGAL_TEXTS` should be `MULTILINGUAL_TEXTS.
The logger.info(i) statement does not provide meaningful information for debugging or understanding test progress. Consider logging the actual text being tokenized or a more descriptive message.
The truncate parameter in the tokenize method is set to `Tokenization.Truncate.FIRST` here, but it was set to `NONE` when building the tokenizer. This inconsistency should be addressed to ensure the test behaves as expected.

The `normalise` method does not handle cases where the input string is longer than the buffer size (64 characters). This could lead to data loss or unexpected behavior. Consider handling larger inputs by resizing the buffer or processing the input in chunks.

The logic for handling character differences seems correct, but the loop for adding offset corrections when characters are inserted can be optimized. Instead of iterating over each character difference, you could add a range correction directly.

review_comment: could you extract all this into a resource file. Then this `XLMRobertaTestVocab` could read and parse from that file so that it is easily used by others. Having all this statically used fields seems overly heavy to me.
